name: Lighting Fast Querier
definition: A class that manages the querying of 3D points from a point cloud for ray marching, handling coordinate transformations, grid indexing via CUDA, and ray generation.
summary: Lighting Fast Querier is a CUDA-accelerated module that maps 3D world coordinates to voxel grid indices for ray marching, distinguished by its integrated ray generation, jittered sampling, and kernel-based query logic optimized for point cloud density.
